claim: Without a recording, verify a patched menu by running it and the original with the same input and comparing memory, system variables, stack, interrupt mode and flags; record it as verification without a recording.

evidence.text: Patched menu versus original menu loading each event from tape, same keys: after 900 frames 0x4000-0xFFFF agree outside the hook, its variables, the system variables 0x5C00-0x5C7F and the stack 0x5F80-0x5FFF; I, IM, IFF agree; a negative control (pages shifted by one) fails all 6 data cases.
evidence.quote: original menu (loads answered at ROM 0x0562 from the tape) run from the snapshot with the same keys; after 900 frames 0x4000-0xFFFF agree
